deities: Kartikeya (Skanda/Murugan, son of Shiva and Parvati)

history.dynasty: Gupta Empire and local Yadava chiefs claimed (single-source, per Inheritage Foundation; verify); later Gurjara-Pratihara-era additions (8th-10th c.)
history.period: c. 450-550 CE (Late Gupta) claimed; legendary Pandava/Yadava association
history.summary: The Kartikeya Temple stands at Nand Colony, Pehowa, beside the sacred Saraswati Tirtha in the ancient Prithudaka pilgrimage zone of Kurukshetra district. Local tradition attributes its origin to the Pandavas and Yadavas of Mahabharata legend; the single detailed source (Inheritage Foundation) dates the present structure's core to the Late Gupta period (c. 450-550 CE), citing Gupta-era foundations and a Kartikeya terracotta figurine from excavations beneath the structure, with later additions in Gurjara-Pratihara styles and Mughal/later-Hindu renovations. The temple is built in the Nagara idiom (stone, brick and lime mortar) with a layered shikhara and carved sandstone panels, and its complex holds several smaller subsidiary shrines. SINGLE-SOURCE WARNING: the detailed history above rests almost entirely on one Inheritage Foundation article, which lists no citation references; treat dates and excavation claims as UNVERIFIED. That article also makes the unusual claim that Kartikeya is represented inside the sanctum by a Shivalinga - UNVERIFIED, no corroboration found. It is surveyed by the ASI, the Kurukshetra Development Board and Haryana Tourism.

name: Kartikeya Temple, Pehowa
town_description: Pehowa is an ancient town in Kurukshetra district, Haryana, on the left bank of the (revived) Saraswati river, about 27 km west of Kurukshetra city. Known in antiquity as Prithudaka, it is one of Haryana's oldest pilgrimage centres, famed as the 'Gaya of the North' for Pind Daan and ancestral rites. 9th-century Gurjara-Pratihara inscriptions record it as a thriving horse market and administrative centre.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi (~180 km) (verify)
travel.road: Pehowa is ~27 km west of Thanesar/Kurukshetra on the Kurukshetra-Pehowa road; the temple is at Nand Colony near the Saraswati Tirtha (verify)

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Kartik Purnima (October-November) for the temple's main celebrations
